name: AgriSurvey Q650 camera quadcopter
description: 650 mm motor-to-motor plus-layout quadcopter for farmland mapping. 15" two-blade props on 4114 400 kV motors, 6S3P 21700 Li-ion pack (324 Wh) strapped on a tray above a white avionics canopy, GNSS on a carbon mast, twin RC/telemetry dipoles, nav LEDs, 300 g survey camera on a 3-axis gimbal hung on damping balls, carbon legs and skids with alloy clamps and tees.

parts.purpose: Lower clamp plate for arms; mounts gimbal and landing legs

parts.name: Top centre plate
parts.purpose: Upper clamp plate; mounts avionics and canopy

parts.purpose: Carries motor thrust back to the body

parts.purpose: Carries motor thrust back to the body

assembly.action: Clamp the four arms between the centre plates with alloy arm clamps and M3 bolts; fit corner standoffs
Clamp motor mounts to arm tips and bolt motors on; alternate CW/CCW
Stick nav LEDs under the arm tips and route leads inside the arms
Mount ESC and FC on soft standoffs on the top plate; wire the battery lead and radio
Fit the canopy; install antenna bulkheads and dipoles, status LED and the folding GPS mast
Place the battery on the tray over the CG, cinch both straps, connect XT90
Hang the damper plate on four damping balls; mount the 3-axis gimbal and balance the camera
Fit legs in clamps under the bottom plate, join to skids with tees, push on end caps
Fit prop hubs and blades last, torque the nuts and check rotation directions

scenarios.title: Arm resonance vs motor/prop at cruise
Hard landing 0.5 m (3.1 m/s) tilted onto one skid: one leg carries half the 4.14 kg aircraft
Level hard landing 0.5 m on a rock mid-span: one skid carries half the 4.14 kg aircraft
25 min hover at 4.14 kg (502 W x 25 min = 209 Wh, as 8.7 W over 24 h) with 20% reserve
